newsitem.title: USA: Unicom Q2 hurt by maintenance costs, weather.
newsitem.headline: Unicom Q2 hurt by maintenance costs, weather.

text.p: Unicom Corp said Friday unseasonably mild weather and increased maintance costs helped lead to a loss in the second quarter.

Increased operation and maintenance expenses, primarily due to nuclear maintenance and improvement projects, reduced earnings by $0.29 a share, the utility company said. Unicom earlier Friday reported a net loss of $18 million, or $0.08 a share in the second quarter, compared to a profit of $100 million, or $0.47 a share a year ago.

Unseasonably mild weather led to a 4.3 percent decrease in kilowatt-hour sales to residential customers for Unicom's Commonwealth Edison Co unit, while sales to retail customers were down 0.5 percent, the company said.
Earnings were also reduced by $36 million, or $0.17 a share, compared to the 1996 quarter due to increased energy costs.

Depreciation expenses in the quarter included $15 million for additional depreciation related to steam generators at Byron 1 and Braidwood 1 nuclear generating stations, which reduced net income by $11 million, or $0.05 a share, the company said.
Unicom shares closed down 5/16 at 21-1/2 Friday.
